name: eslint-preset
description: ESLint flat-config preset carrying Diorama's import boundaries into a consumer app: griddy-icons only (no other icon set), no second component library or design language, and the motion limits of CONVENTIONS §8 / ADR 0018 (no framer-motion, no motion/react component API, no GSAP without a licensing decision; motion/mini is allowed). Dependency-free plain objects: spread the default export into your flat config, or build your own no-restricted-imports from the exported restrictedImports lists (ESLint replaces, never merges, a rule's options). Package names are exact `paths`, never gitignore-style `patterns`, so @/lib/motion is never caught by a rule meant for the motion package.
